title: Manager I, Performance Marketing

company.name: Scopely
company.blurb: Global mobile games company behind Monopoly GO!, Stumble Guys and MARVEL Strike Force.

description_md:
Scopely is looking for a **Performance Marketing Manager I **to join our **User Acquisition team** in Canada on a remote basis!

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

The User Acquisition team is focused on driving player growth and efficiency across various digital marketing channels. The teams are based in Europe and the US. The UA team’s mobile advertising ecosystem is an always-changing, rapidly growing world, and at Scopely, you'll play a key part in our next big leap in user growth. Our mission is to make experiences that our players love and keep coming back to time and time again.

**What You’ll Do:**

- Independently manage significant performance marketing budgets across multiple channels to maximize games’ growth and profitability

- Strategize, execute and continually optimize mobile campaigns on every critical mobile platform, including: Meta, Google, TikTok, DSP Networks, SDK Networks, CTV, Influencer marketing, and much more

- Locate, negotiate and develop creative and innovative solutions for acquisition

- Grow and manage marketing partnerships for UA efforts across the globe

- Design and execute A/B & multivariate testing and present results to related teams

- Contribute winning ad creative ideas and run creative testing, working closely with Marketing to execute on breakthrough creative strategies to attract new users

- Work cross-functionally with product, ads, data, and creative teams to grow the portfolio and business through full-view lifecycle marketing

- Be an expert in UA with key knowledge in order to lead a team

- Raise flags for future potential issues that might arise if we continue on course or due to expected changes based on our current methodology

- Proactively source new partners to diversify portfolio

- Ability to present and speak in front of leadership stakeholders from varying functions

**What We’re Looking For: **

- BA or BS degree, preferably in Economics, Mathematics, Marketing, Communications, Finance, Business Administration or a related field

- 3-5 years of experience in media buying / user acquisition / performance marketing.

- A hunger to be at the forefront of the mobile advertising space and the mobile app market

- Creative problem solving acumen, as well as analytical rigor to verify or invalidate assumptions

- Strong analytical skills and attention to detail

- Proven ability to effectively communicate with cross functional teams

- Prefer candidates with direct previous experience in mobile user acquisition. Hands-on experience with Facebook Ads and/or Google Ads is a plus

- Understanding of funnel conversion metrics, retention rates and LTV predictions preferred

- Deep understanding of our data architecture and tech stack, and be able to communicate effectively with data teams

- Looks for external emerging trends

- Ability to self-reflect, take feedback and create a personal improvement plan

- Ability to follow-up on tasks and action items with no or little oversight

- Strong proficiency with Excel required

At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that!   We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us & embrace the adventure!

We welcome applications from people with disabilities and should you require accommodations during the application process please contact Interview-Accomodations@scopely.com.

For candidates in British Columbia, the annual salary range is provided below. In addition to base pay, employees may be eligible for equity, bonuses, and a comprehensive benefits package, including healthcare benefits, retirement benefits, pet insurance, paid holidays, paid Scopely free days, and unlimited paid time off. Base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

British Columbia Annual Salary Range

$80,000, $105,000 USD

**About Scopely**

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry ,  bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team ,  including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses ,  Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good ,  creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/.

description_md:

The Marketing team deeply understands a game’s audience, creative strategy and priorities. They are the glue between the Brand, Product, and our Player Communities that will redefine our social strategy to amplify our games across new and existing social channels while building a meaningful community for our players.

**What You Will Do**

You'll help shape and run the influencer marketing initiatives that turn creator content into measurable impact - managing budget, agency relationships, and the day-to-day operations that keep every campaign on track.

You'll balance performance-oriented influencer marketing (installs, CPI, ROAS) with brand-oriented influencer marketing (awareness, community, brand voice), working closely with UA/performance marketing, brand and legal/IP teams. Staying on top of market trends and best practices in mobile performance marketing are key.  Responsibilities include:

- **Run Influencer Marketing Operations**: Own creator selection and vetting, content brief coordination, and campaign flighting across YouTube, Meta, TikTok, and Twitch for multiple game titles.

- **Own Agency Relationships**: Negotiate rates with talent agencies, resolving day-to-day issues as campaigns run.

- **Support Influencer Marketing Strategy**: Help shape the creator strategy across the portfolio and translate it into operational plans, timelines, and campaign briefs.

- **Help Build and Share Strategy Deck**s: Share influencer campaign plans and budget scenarios with cross-functional stakeholders, including performance/UA audiences who expect CPI and CPM, not just reach and volume metrics.

- **Manage Vendor Operations**: Onboard new creator and agency suppliers and liaise with procurement and finance teams to keep operations.

- **Track Performance**: Use MMPs (Singular, Adjust, AppsFlyer) and dashboarding tools (Looker) to monitor influencer campaign performance across funnel stages and trigger optimizations.

- **Own Reporting Cadence**: Deliver campaign recaps, end-of-campaign wrap reports with learnings, and executive-level presentations, keeping stakeholders aligned on both strategy and execution status.

**What We're Looking For**

We're seeking an experienced, execution-focused Creator Strategy and Growth Manager who can help shape influencer marketing strategy and run the day-to-day operations that bring it to life. Qualifications include:

- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field

- Experience in influencer marketing, creator marketing, or a related discipline, ideally in gaming

- Strong knowledge of CPM/rate benchmarks and hands-on experience negotiating pricing and terms with talent agencies

- Comfort owning operational details ,  contracts, invoices, budget pacing, vendor paperwork ,  alongside higher-level strategy

- Strong analytical skills

- Strong Google Sheets/Excel skills, plus working knowledge of MMPs and data visualization tools (ideally Looker)

- Clear, confident written and verbal communication for both internal stakeholders and external agency partners

- Comfort prioritizing across competing timelines and stakeholders, context-switching between brand voices, and understanding of IP guidelines across a portfolio of titles

**Bonus Points**

- Gaming industry experience

- Knowledge of creator/ambassador programs and reward mechanisms (e.g. rewarded deep links, promo codes)

- Experience working directly with UA/performance marketing teams on influencer and creator marketing

- Familiarity with influencer disclosure requirements

description_md:
At Kabam, we’re constantly raising the bar of excellence in free-to-play gaming. We hire for passion and diversity so that we can triumph in our collective skill. Our teams are made up of a fusion of personalities and interests bound together by a collaborative nature, fun-loving culture, and a drive to do what it takes to make great games. And this is where you come in...

Kabam is looking for a Contract Video Artist  to support the creative services team for 1 year. You will be responsible for capturing high-quality gameplay footage and imagery and supporting video editing tasks across our portfolio of titles - including Marvel Contest of Champions and Shop Titans - for use in marketing materials, both static and video.

**This role is a full-time, on-site position based 5 days a week at our Downtown Vancouver studio.In this role, you can expect to:**

title: Growth Associate - End of study internship

company.name: Voodoo
company.blurb: Paris-based mobile games and apps publisher, one of the largest hypercasual and hybrid-casual UA operations in the world.

description_md:
**About Voodoo**

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 1000 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publishers worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

**Team**

Our Growth team is a transversal entity aiming to maximize and deliver the potential of any mobile product by leveraging performance marketing. It combines user acquisition, creative content production, monetization, and the tech capabilities required to turn applications into global hits. With over 150 experts, we operate at the forefront of mobile marketing and ad tech across various types of games (hybrid and casual).

**Role**

Mobile gaming is a $100B+ market, with over 3 billion players worldwide and more revenue than console and PC combined. The marketing operations behind the biggest games, acquiring users at scale, optimizing monetization, iterating on creative, are among the most data-intensive in the industry.

As a **Growth Associate**, you'll work directly on products with big potential to become iconic (games or consumer apps), alongside Growth experts and getting hands-on with campaigns, creative, data and real business challenges from day one.

Depending on business needs and open opportunities, you'll join one of the following teams:

- **User Acquisition:** Manage and optimize paid campaigns across Meta, Google, TikTok, and more. You'll run bid, audience, and creative tests, develop a sharp instinct for what hooks work and why, and scale what performs. UA Managers at Voodoo are hands-on across the full creative process, from ideation to iteration, not just media buying.

- **Playable Ads:** Design and develop high-impact playable ads that drive user acquisition for our mobile games. You'll research audience preferences, conceive game concepts tailored for interactive ads, and iterate rapidly to maximize campaign performance and scale.

- **Monetization:** Analyze how users interact with our ad stack and monetization flows. You'll run experiments on placements, formats, and user segmentation to maximize revenue while protecting retention metrics, and test new monetization solutions through our portfolio that can generate massive uplifts on our revenues.

- **Account Management (B2B): **Work with external publishers using Voodoo's platform to grow their apps. Help them interpret their data, improve their performance, and get the most out of the tools we build for them.

A Growth Associate role provides structured entry into the Growth team. Succeeding here opens **clear paths into expert-level or leadership positions**, depending on your direction and performance.

**If you thrive on challenges and want to join a fast-paced company that’s changing the future of mobile games and apps, now is your chance!For all our opportunities, it starts as a final-year internship, and converts to a permanent contract based on performance.Profile**

- Final-year student from a **top engineering or business school (Programme Grande Ecole)**, looking for your** end-of-study internship for January 2027**

- Clear communicator, **fluent both in English and French**

- Strong analytical mindset; comfortable digging into data to make decisions

- Genuine interest in mobile apps, games, or performance marketing

- Autonomous and proactive; you'd rather figure things out than wait to be told

 

**Benefits**

- Swile Lunch voucher

- Gymlib (100% covered by Voodoo)

- Wellness activities in our Paris office

- Remote days on Fridays

title: VP of Marketing [User Acquisition]

description_md:
This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000).

We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 70 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world.

At Almedia, you’ll:

- **Own way more, way earlier** ,  you’ll be trusted with responsibility fast.

- **Push harder, get further** ,  this isn’t a 9–5. We highly reward intensity.

- **Join a rare environment** ,  you will work with ambitious high-speed, high-ownership people.

- **Fully present** ,  we’re 5 days a week in the office to build the energising momentum we need.

**Salary:** 150-200k • Total Comp: 300k • Includes Equity

We are seeking a seasoned and visionary **VP of Marketing [User Acquisition]** to lead all marketing efforts for Almedia. This is a critical leadership role that will take full ownership of our user acquisition channels, influencer programs, and future marketing projects. You will be instrumental in maximizing our overall growth and scaling our user base for Freecash and other ventures. If you are a strategic leader with a proven track record of managing diverse marketing channels, building high-performing teams, and driving business-level impact, this is your opportunity to shape the future of a rapidly growing company.

**What You'll Do 🎯**

- **Define & Own Marketing Strategy:** Develop, define, and execute the overarching marketing and user acquisition strategy for Almedia, ensuring it's aligned with ambitious growth targets and business objectives.

- **Lead & Mentor High-Performing Teams:** Oversee and mentor the teams responsible for paid media, influencer marketing, and other growth initiatives, fostering a culture of ownership, data-driven decision-making, and continuous improvement.

- **Drive Multi-Channel Growth:** Take full ownership of all marketing channels, from established platforms like Google Ads and Meta to emerging channels, ensuring optimal budget allocation, execution, and performance across all areas.

- **Pioneer New Projects:** Spearhead the launch of new marketing projects from inception to completion, identifying untapped opportunities and transforming them into scalable, high-impact channels.

- **Collaborate for Business Impact:** Work closely with the CEO, VP of People, and other stakeholders to translate marketing efforts into clear business outcomes, providing strategic insights that drive the company's growth.

**What You'll Bring 💡**

- **Extensive Marketing Leadership:** Proven track record in a senior marketing role, with experience leading and scaling multi-channel user acquisition efforts and managing diverse teams.

- **Strategic & Analytical Expertise:** Exceptional ability to build a comprehensive marketing strategy, leverage data and analytics to inform decisions, and communicate complex insights to a C-level audience.

- **Hands-On Ownership:** A history of taking full ownership of projects, from managing day-to-day operations and budgets to defining long-term strategic goals.

- **People & Process Management:** Strong leadership skills in mentoring and developing team members, as well as building and implementing scalable processes for marketing and project management.

- **Deep Industry Knowledge:** A comprehensive understanding of the mobile ad-tech and gaming ecosystem, including key players, monetization strategies, and user acquisition best practices.

title: Creative Producer

description_md:
We are looking for a Creative Producer to join the Creative Strategy team at Wildlife. This is a role for someone who has spent their career making audiovisual work ,  writing, directing, producing ,  and who wants to apply that craft to advertising creative that runs at scale and is measured every day.

You will own the creative production pipeline for one or more of our games, working alongside Product Marketing Managers and our in-house Creative Studio team. You create and prioritize the ideas that get produced, and you stay close enough to production to make sure the idea survives execution.

You are accountable for the quality of the creative that goes out for the games under your scope, and for finding whatever you need to get there: pulling numbers, asking PMMs and Game Directors, studying what competitors are running, and using AI to move faster through research, benchmarking, and analysis.

What you'll do

You will generate creative concepts for the games under your scope and carry them from idea to script. You will work from competitor benchmarks, market and network trends across media channels, player signals, and performance results, and turn that material into a line of ideas the team can produce. We expect ideas that go further than the reference that inspired them.

You will write scripts and briefs that the Creative Studio and external providers can build from. You will direct production across video, playable, and static pieces, with a point of view on treatment, pacing, edit, and animation approach, reviewing cuts until the ad delivers what the idea promised. You will bring taste and creative judgment to the work, critiquing, refining, and holding the quality line.

You will read creative performance across metrics like Spend Share, IPM, CTR, CPI, ROAS, hook and hold rates, and use that read to decide what to iterate, what to scale, and what to abandon. You will follow test methodologies with PMMs and Data Scientists, and document learnings into the team's structured knowledge base, so insight compounds across creatives, games, and time.

What you'll need

- A senior track record in audiovisual production or creative direction ,  in a production company, an in-house studio, an agency, or as an independent director.

- A portfolio of work you directed or produced. This is the main input we will evaluate, and we will ask you to walk us through the decisions behind specific pieces.

- Scriptwriting as a practiced craft, from concept to shooting or animation script.

- Experience directing animation and motion work, enough to brief it, critique it, and correct it.

- Openness to go deep on performance marketing logic and metrics. Prior experience is welcome, and what we ask for is the willingness to learn it: digging into results, understanding why a creative won or lost, and using that to adjust the next round.

- Comfort with AI as part of daily workflow. You do not need to be technical, but you need to engage with AI tools as leverage.

- Excellent written and verbal communication, in English and Portuguese.

Nice to have

- Experience in mobile gaming or app marketing.

- Experience with playable ads, or with interactive formats.

- Familiarity with market intelligence tools (Sensor Tower, AppMagic, or similar) used to extract competitive insight.

- Experience running or reading structured A/B tests on creative.

More about you

- You have taste. You can tell good from great and you can articulate why.

- You generate ideas under pressure, in volume, without the quality dropping as the count goes up. Given a product, an audience, and a deadline, you can put a range of concepts on the table and defend the reasoning behind each one.

- You are curious about the market by default. You watch what works, you track competitors, you keep a running library of references without being asked.

- You are pragmatic about iteration. You do not get attached to your ideas. You get attached to learning.

description_md:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to **250 employees** while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a **$400 million Series D** at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination.

About the Role

We're making our first CRO hire to own conversion at Suno, across web and the app stores. You'll sit on the Growth team at the point where our marketing spend turns into revenue: the landing pages, app store listings, funnels, and copy people hit after they click an ad, land from search, or find us in the App Store.

 

This is a performance job. You'll live in the numbers – conversion rate, install rate, CAC, revenue per visitor – and tie every test you run back to what it did for the business. You'll own the strategy and the copy, build pages and listings from our existing design system, and ship experiments at a pace that surprises people. You'll understand our ideal customer better than anyone in the building – who they are, what brings them to Suno, and what makes them convert ,  and shape every page, listing, and test around that.

 

You'll partner with User Acquisition, Lifecycle, Product, Engineering, and Data Science, and you'll work within our existing design system rather than in Figma yourself ,  grab a template, own the copy and the test, and ship. Conversion is yours to run. This is a senior IC role with real ownership and no team to manage. We want a hacker: someone scrappy and relentless who finds the fast path, ships more tests than anyone thinks is possible, and cares about learning fast and at scale more than about building the perfect system.

Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/vVeA30cOueLXfw8R

What You'll Do

- Understand our ideal customer more deeply than anyone else here, and turn that into pages, listings, copy, and tests that actually speak to them

- Ship a high volume of landing pages across paid, SEO, lifecycle, partnerships, and new launches, assembled from our existing design system and tailored to the channel and audience each serves

- Own app store optimization: the listing copy, screenshots, and store creative that turn store visits into installs, and the handoff into onboarding

- Localize and adapt pages and store listings for our international markets, so conversion holds up across languages and regions

- Write persuasive, on-brand copy and build pages from our existing design components, then test your way to better versions fast

- Run experiments at real volume: A/B and multivariate tests shipped quickly, using AI and whatever scrappy tooling gets you more shots on goal than the team could hit by hand

- Dig into user behavior with heatmaps, session recordings, surveys, and analytics to find where people drop off and why

- Hunt down the highest-leverage opportunities across the funnel by combining performance data, user research, and business context

- Own the conversion numbers end to end across web and app: conversion rate, install rate, CAC, and revenue per visitor, paid and organic

- Partner with Revenue Product on paywall and upsell copy, keeping it clear and true to what people are getting

- Push conversion testing to a volume and speed Suno hasn't seen, and pull the rest of the company along with what you learn

Qualifications

- You're a hacker. You move fast and ship a lot, and you've run a high volume of tests without a big team behind you

- 5-8 years in performance marketing, growth marketing, or CRO. You've owned conversion and funnel testing at scale, on the web and in the app stores (including ASO)

- You can write. You've written landing page copy that actually converted, and you know the customer well enough to know what to say to them

- You can read an experiment and know what it's telling you. We use Statsig internally, so you're comfortable pulling results, judging significance, and deciding what to do next

- You know the landing page toolkit. You've built and tested pages in tools like Optimizely, VWO, or Unbounce, and watched behavior in Clarity or Hotjar

- You set your own KPIs and run your own analysis. You can take user data and research and turn it into a test plan that ties back to the business

- You use AI to get more done than one person normally could

- You can tell a real win from a cheap trick, and you won't ship dark patterns. You work well with product and engineering and get changes live without slowing everyone down

Additional Notes

Applicants must be eligible to work in the US, and willing to work 5 days/week at our office in NYC.

Compensation

$160k - $190k base salary (before equity)

Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees

- Company Equity Package

- 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

- Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

- 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

- 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

- Creative Education Stipend

- Generous Commuter Allowance

- In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

title: Head of Performance Marketing

company.name: Supercell
company.blurb: Helsinki studio behind Clash of Clans, Clash Royale and Brawl Stars.

description_md:
Lead the marketing engine behind some of the world's most iconic mobile games.

We’re looking for a Head of Performance Marketing to join Supercell – someone who combines strategic capability and clarity, technical depth, and people-first leadership. You’ll lead our Performance Marketing function, including world-class Performance Marketing teams, ASO, and CRM, driving growth for some of the world’s most iconic mobile games while enabling a talented team to do their best work.

You’ll be deeply embedded in the business by balancing creative ambition with operational excellence, and turning data, technology, and insight into growth.

You will lead a talented team responsible for driving user acquisition and cross-media operations across Supercell’s live and future games. Our Performance Marketing team operates both centrally and embedded within game teams – you’ll need to set direction and enable success across both models, building the systems and culture that empower the team wherever they sit.

This is a role for someone who leads with clarity and empathy, sees the bigger picture without losing sight of impact, and navigates complex organizations with diplomacy and confidence. You’ll partner closely with leaders and teams across Game teams, Marketing, Data & Analytics, Finance, and Creative Production to ensure our media strategies drive long-term growth and business impact.

We pride ourselves on the level of thoughtfulness, quality, and focus put into every aspect of our work. Be it the games themselves or how we communicate them to our players, we are passionate about not compromising on quality ever and choosing a long-term approach to make Supercell a truly global games company that will last for many decades to come.

Let us know if you are who we are looking for!

**What You'll Be Doing**

- Shape the strategic vision and direction for Supercell’s Performance Marketing function, ensuring alignment with company and game-level business goals. Drive cross-functional alignment through openness, integrity, and collaboration – ensuring clarity of direction across marketing, analytics, and operations.

- Lead and develop a high-performing team of Performance Marketing, ASO, and CRM professionals; setting clear goals, fostering autonomy, and creating an environment where people do their best work.

- Build and maintain measurement frameworks, governance structures, and operational systems that enable the team to perform at their best, alongside coaching and culture that help individuals grow.

- Build strong partnerships with Game Leads, Marketing Leads, Data, and Finance to ensure marketing investment decisions are data-informed, scalable, and business-driven.

- Oversee media strategy and governance – ensuring that Supercell’s global marketing efforts are effective, efficient, and future-proofed against evolving market dynamics.

- Own CRM as a strategic growth lever – ensuring lifecycle and retention strategy is tightly integrated with user acquisition, game-level priorities, and long-term business goals.

- Embrace AI curiosity and capability – comfortable working with AI-powered campaign tools and platforms, you understand how algorithms make decisions and how to work with them, not just around them. This includes using AI for workflow automation, creative production, and campaign optimization, while staying honest about the trade-offs involved.

- Push boundaries. Take bold bets. Own risks and back your team when it counts.

**What you have**

- Extensive leadership experience in performance marketing and media or operations with a proven track record of leading high-impact, high-scale teams in complex, global organizations.

- Deep understanding of performance marketing and user acquisition, with the ability to translate complex technical and data-driven concepts into strategic direction. This includes a strong grasp of product dynamics and the interaction between UA and product – understanding how marketing decisions shape and are shaped by the player experience and game economy.

- Player-first mindset. You believe great marketing ultimately serves the player experience, not just the metrics.

- Portfolio-level experience managing marketing investment across multiple products at different lifecycle stages, with the ability to allocate, prioritize, and adapt strategy as games grow, mature, or launch.

- Strong business and financial mindset, able to connect marketing performance to commercial outcomes and broader company goals.

- Fluent in data and analytics, with the ability to guide strategic decision-making in collaboration with data science and analytics teams.

- Exceptional stakeholder management skills, capable of influencing senior leaders and aligning diverse perspectives around shared priorities.

- Diplomatic and emotionally intelligent, with the ability to lead through trust, clarity, and empathy – even in ambiguity.

- A builder of people and culture, passionate about coaching, growing, and empowering others to succeed.

- Passion for games and building systems that last.

- A self-starter approach to use AI. You've found ways to use it in your day-to-day work, you experiment, figure things out and bring the same energy to every new challenge.

**Where You'll Be**

This role can be based either in Helsinki or London. The team members are located in both our Helsinki and London Studios; however, most of our team members and stakeholders are located in Helsinki!

To be successful, you'll be expected to travel regularly in this role, especially if based out of London.

–––

That's it about the role! Below, we've gathered some things we feel are important for you to know. Totally optional, but a highly recommended read.

Once you're ready to apply, just send us your application through the form on the bottom of the page.

–––

**About Supercell **

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars. Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings, and killing lots of projects.

**Hey, You Might Love It Here!**

Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture. But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way.

**You Are Not Your Job Title ™**

Here, you won’t need to focus on chasing titles or climbing ladders. Internally, our job titles don’t include prefixes like Senior, Junior, Principal, or Director. Recognition isn’t tied to your title, as it doesn't define the impact you can have around here.

**Benefits and Compensation **

Luring you in with glitter, glamour, and gems isn't what we're about. We want you to enjoy your time here fully, so we structure our compensation and benefits with that in mind. It starts with perceiving you as a human being, not a resource.

**Relocation? Yes!**

No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind!

**Not Sure if You Should Apply? **

Many candidates with great skills and experience second-guess themselves. The bar is high, but if this role excites you, apply! We’re here to help you succeed. Also, we're happy to learn about any specific accommodations you may need to fully engage in our recruitment process.

Wishing you all the best,
The Supercell Recruitment team

We are looking for a highly skilled, performance-minded Senior Motion Designer to join our Creative Studio. In this role, you will be the creative engine behind our User Acquisition (UA) video ads, crafting high-converting, visually efficient video assets across paid social and programmatic channels (TikTok, Meta, YouTube, Unity, etc.).

You’ll blend UGC plates, gameplay storytelling, slick animations, and data-backed creative insights to scale our global user base.

You are curious, eager to explore, analyze, and optimize.

What You’ll Do

End-to-End UA Video Production: Concept, storyboard, design, animate, and edit high-impact, short-form video ads optimized for mobile UA channels.

Creative Iteration & Scaling: Take winning ad concepts and rapidly produce high-quality variations (hooks, CTAs, gameplay mechanics, sound design, visual styles) to combat ad fatigue and test performance hypotheses.

Collaborate with Creative & UA Teams: Partner closely with Motion Designers, Creative Strategists, Copywriters, and UA Managers to align visual concepts with performance metrics (CPI, ROAS, IPM).

Innovate & Trend Watch: Stay ahead of mobile gaming trends, platform-specific editing styles (TikTok/Reels native style vs. cinematic gameplay), and creative tech/AI workflows to continuously elevate our creative output.

Mentorship & Quality Standards: Help set the bar for visual quality, animation polish, and workflow efficiency across the UA Creative team.

What We’re Looking For

5-7+ years of professional motion design experience, with a strong focus on mobile User Acquisition (UA), direct-response marketing, or performance creative.

Mastery of Adobe Creative Cloud (After Effects, Premiere Pro, Photoshop, Illustrator) with deep expertise in 2D animation, typography, editing, visual storytelling, and kinetic text.

Mobile Gaming Native: A strong understanding of mobile game mechanics, gameplay editing, and mobile UI/UX visual language.

- Familiarity with AI-driven creative tools (Midjourney, Runway, Stable Diffusion) to speed up concepting and asset generation.

Performance-Driven Mindset: You don't just care about making things look good, you understand why a 3-second hook works, how visual pacing drives conversion, and how to read creative performance data.

Sound & Storytelling Expertise: Excellent sense of pacing, rhythm, audio mixing, and sound design tailored for short-form, mobile-first video.

Strong Portfolio/Reel: A robust showreel demonstrating high-end motion graphics, engaging video ads, and dynamic visual storytelling (specifically in mobile, gaming, or app marketing).

Nice-to-Haves

Experience with 3D motion design (Cinema 4D, Blender, or Maya).

Experience with interactive ads (playable ads, HTML5) or Unity/Unreal Engine asset extraction.

Why Join Mistplay?

High Impact: Your work directly drives company revenue, user growth, and brand presence globally.

Creative Autonomy: A culture that encourages rapid experimentation, bold concepts, and continuous learning.

Growth & Culture: Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, flexible working arrangements, and a collaborative team of passionate gamers and creators.

Français:

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un concepteur ou d'une conceptrice en animation (Senior Motion Designer) de haut niveau, axé sur la performance, pour rejoindre notre studio de création. Dans ce rôle, vous serez le moteur créatif de nos publicités vidéo d'acquisition d'utilisateurs (UA) ,  en créant des éléments vidéo à fort taux de conversion et visuellement efficaces sur les médias sociaux payants et les canaux programmatiques (TikTok, Meta, YouTube, Unity, etc.).

Vous combinerez des séquences de contenu généré par les utilisateurs (UGC), du récit de jeu (gameplay), des animations fluides et des données créatives pour accroître notre base d'utilisateurs mondiale.

Vous êtes de nature curieuse et vous avez hâte d'explorer, d'analyser et d'optimiser.

Ce que vous ferez

Production vidéo UA de bout en bout : Concevoir, scénariser, designer, animer et monter des publicités vidéo percutantes de format court, optimisées pour les canaux d'acquisition mobile.

Itération créative et mise à l'échelle : Reprendre les concepts publicitaires gagnants et produire rapidement des variations de haute qualité (accroches, appels à l'action, mécaniques de jeu, conception sonore, styles visuels) pour contrer la fatigue publicitaire et tester des hypothèses de performance.

Collaboration avec les équipes créatives et UA : Collaborer étroitement avec les concepteurs en animation, les stratèges créatifs, les rédacteurs et les gestionnaires UA pour aligner les concepts visuels avec les mesures de performance (CPI, ROAS, IPM).

Innovation et veille sur les tendances : Rester à l'affût des tendances du jeu mobile, des styles de montage propres aux plateformes (style natif TikTok/Reels vs gameplay cinématique) et des flux de travail technologiques créatifs/IA pour élever continuellement notre production créative.

Mentorat et normes de qualité : Aider à établir les standards de qualité visuelle, de finition d'animation et d'efficacité opérationnelle au sein de l'équipe créative UA.

Ce que nous recherchons

5-7+ ans d'expérience professionnelle en conception d'animation, avec une solide expertise en acquisition d'utilisateurs mobiles (UA), en marketing de réponse directe ou en création axée sur la performance.

Maîtrise d'Adobe Creative Cloud (After Effects, Premiere Pro, Photoshop, Illustrator) avec une expertise approfondie en animation 2D, typographie, montage, récit visuel et texte cinétique.

Passionné(e) de jeux mobiles : Une compréhension approfondie des mécaniques de jeu mobile, du montage de gameplay et du langage visuel UI/UX mobile.

- Connaissance des outils créatifs basés sur l'IA (Midjourney, Runway, Stable Diffusion) pour accélérer la conceptualisation et la génération d'actifs.

Esprit axé sur la performance : Vous ne vous contentez pas de créer de beaux visuels ,  vous comprenez pourquoi une accroche de 3 secondes fonctionne, comment le rythme visuel stimule la conversion et comment interpréter les données de performance créative.

Expertise en son et en narration : Un excellent sens du rythme, du mixage audio et de la conception sonore adaptés à la vidéo courte pensée pour le mobile.

Portfolio ou démo solide : Une démo robuste démontrant des graphismes animés de haute qualité, des publicités vidéo attrayantes et un récit visuel dynamique (particulièrement dans le domaine du mobile, des jeux ou du marketing d'applications).

Atouts (Nice-to-Haves)

Expérience en conception d'animation 3D (Cinema 4D, Blender ou Maya).

Expérience avec les publicités interactives (playable ads, HTML5) ou l'extraction d'actifs Unity/Unreal Engine.

description_md:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to **250 employees** while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a **$400 million Series D** at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination.

**About the Role**

Suno is growing fast, and paid social creative is a major driver of that growth. The right person for this role takes Suno's brand identity and pushes it into performance creative that earns attention and converts – work that drives growth and brings the excitement of using Suno to everyone who sees it.

This is a hybrid graphic and motion design role on the performance marketing team. You'll own the branded paid social creative pipeline: conceiving, producing, and iterating on work across static and motion formats. You'll work closely with the performance marketing team, treating data and channel insights as creative inputs rather than afterthoughts. Over time, you'll help build the workflows and systems that let us scale without losing what makes Suno's creative distinctive. As the team grows, there's a path to managing other creative contributors.

Check out the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/dDrWV7XNe6I5mJax

**What You'll Do**

- Translate Suno's brand identity and creative DNA into paid social creative that drives growth across paid channels (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, etc.)

- Own the full branded creative pipeline – concepting, producing, and iterating on static and motion assets

- Build and maintain a creative roadmap: what to make, what to test, what to push further, and what to move on from

- Partner with the performance marketing team to use data and channel feedback as creative inputs, not just outputs

- Use AI tools to extend creative output beyond what's manually possible – and help build the processes and guardrails that keep AI-assisted work on-brand and up to Suno's standards

- Develop workflows and production processes that scale creative output without diluting brand quality

- Help shape how the next generation of creators discovers Suno – the creative you make is often their first impression

**What You'll NeedMust-Haves**

- 4-6 years in performance creative, paid social design, or growth-focused creative at a consumer tech, DTC, or growth-stage company

- Hybrid graphic and motion design skills: strong static design fundamentals and real motion/animation capability – this is not a pure graphic design role

- Portfolio of paid social work (static and motion) that demonstrates both craft and a performance orientation

- Expert-level proficiency in Figma, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, and After Effects

- Fluency in what makes paid social creative work: hooks, formats, platform conventions, and what drives meaningful iteration

- Ability to internalize a brand's visual identity and push it into new formats without losing what makes it distinctive

**Nice-to-Haves**

- Hands-on experience with AI-assisted creative tools (generative image, video, or copy) as part of a real production workflow

- Background in music, entertainment, or creator-focused consumer products

- Experience managing or mentoring junior creative contributors

Compensation

$75 - $90 per hour

Additional Notes

20-40 hours per week

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

title: Experienced UA Manager

company.blurb: Hypercasual and hybrid-casual mobile games publisher.

description_md:
**The role**

Take full ownership of user acquisition across a portfolio of games: budgets, creative strategy, and automation. You will be challenged on the ROAS you generate and the scalability of the systems you build, not on the number of campaigns you launch.

**Responsibilities**

Being the game owner of your portfolio including:

- Independently managing UA campaigns across all major networks (Meta, Google, TikTok, AppLovin, Unity, Mintegral, etc.) and running continuous testing.

- Owning the acquisition P&L of your titles: Spend, CPI, D120 ROAS, Margin, LTV, and Payback.

- Driving creative strategy with the creative team: hypothesis design, use of AI generation tools, and systematic analysis of winning and losing concepts

- Closing the loop between UA, monetization, and retention in collaboration with the Data and Product teams

- Building the UA automation infrastructure: budget and ROAS monitoring agents, optimization rules through network APIs, automated reporting and alerting connected to the MMP and the data stack

- Anticipating ecosystem changes (SKAN, privacy, new channels) rather than reacting to them

**Requirements**

- **2 to 3 years of mobile gaming UA experience**, including significant experience in hyper-casual or hybrid-casual

- **A verifiable track record**: you can name the titles you scaled, provide before-and-after figures, and explain precisely what you did

- **Perfect understanding of attribution**: MMPs (Adjust, AppsFlyer), post-ATT measurement, SKAN ,  you understand the limits of each measurement model and can make sound decisions despite uncertainty

- **Full analytical autonomy**: comfortable with Looker or equivalent, able to build your own LTV models without relying on the data team

- **Demonstrated automation experience**: you have built systems (Python scripts, network APIs, n8n, LLM agents) that run in production, and you can describe them in technical detail

- Fluent English required

This role requires direct ownership of campaigns and budgets. If your automation experience is limited to consuming dashboards, this position is unlikely to be the right fit.

**Nice to have**

- AI agents in production for creative analysis or campaign optimization

- Strong Python skills beyond basic scripting

- Fluent in SQL

- End-to-end experience taking titles from soft launch to global launch

Gist is a new social media platform for people who want substance ,  practical, thoughtful content that spans philosophy debates, city-specific recommendations, seasonal gift guides, and wellness tips. Across categories like travel, food, career, and family, we describe it as "a handbook for the curious."

Gist is built by AppLovin Corporation ,  a company that hit $5.3B in revenue last year and sits alongside Google and Meta as one of the world's leading ad tech platforms. Fortune recognizes AppLovin as one of the Best Workplaces in the Bay Area, and the company has been a Certified Great Place to Work for the last four years (2021–2024).

**The Role**

We're hiring a founding Performance Marketing Manager to own all of paid growth for Gist ,  every channel, every dollar, every partnership. You'll set the performance marketing strategy, build the measurement foundation, and run the testing loops across Meta, TikTok, Google, and programmatic that give us real control over CAC from day one. No team to delegate to, no playbook to inherit. You are the expert in the room, and everything paid runs through you.

**What You'll OwnEvery paid channel.** You are the channel manager across the full performance marketing mix: Meta, TikTok, Google, programmatic, ad networks, and any emerging channel worth testing. You decide where we spend, how much, and why ,  and you live with the results.

**Off-platform partnerships.** Beyond self-serve ad platforms, you will identify, negotiate, and manage relationships with external partners ,  media companies, OEM and on-device distribution partners, ad networks, affiliate and performance platforms, publisher direct buys, and other non-standard acquisition channels. You own these relationships end-to-end: partner evaluation, deal structure, execution, and ongoing performance management.

**Budget and efficiency. **Own the monthly performance marketing budget with full accountability to CAC, CPI, LTV, and ROAS. Allocate across channels and partners dynamically based on performance, scale what works, cut what doesn't, and report spend decisions clearly to leadership.

**Measurement and analytics.** Work on tracking setup to extract meaningful signal ,  diagnosing performance shifts, identifying what's working and what isn't, and translating data into clear actions. You are comfortable going deep into the numbers independently, spotting anomalies before they become problems, and working cross-functionally with product, data, and engineering teams to investigate and resolve issues collaboratively.

**Creative and channel testing.** Run structured tests across audiences, creatives, bidding strategies, ad formats, and partner inventory. Treat every campaign and partnership as a hypothesis. Document what you learn and build a compounding playbook over time.

**The full funnel.** You are accountable not just for installs but for quality users. Partner with product and growth teams to understand post-install behaviour, feed those insights back into performance marketing strategy and creative direction, and optimise toward activation and retention, not just volume.

**New distribution thinking.** A new social platform lives or dies by how it finds its first million users. Beyond standard channels, you will proactively explore non-obvious distribution: influencer/KOL paid amplification, content seeding partnerships, cross-platform distribution deals, incentivised install ecosystems, and anything else early data suggests is worth testing.

**What We're Looking For**

● 3-7 years of brand-side performance marketing experience, with direct ownership of budgets and outcomes for a consumer app, marketplace, or digital product

● Proven experience driving growth from cold start ,  you have launched performance marketing for a new product or market from zero, not just optimised an existing system, and you know what it takes to find the first users before there is any data to work with

● Hands-on fluency across Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, and Google Ads; programmatic and ad network experience a strong plus

● Demonstrated experience managing off-platform or non-self-serve partnerships ,  ad networks, OEM or device partnerships, media direct buys, affiliate or performance platforms, or similar; you have negotiated deals and managed these relationships independently

● Mobile attribution tooling experience with Adjust or equivalent; able to set up and own measurement infrastructure end-to-end, not just read reports someone else configured

● Thinks in the right metrics: CAC, CPI, LTV, ROAS, Day 7/30 payback, and funnel conversion rates ,  and can diagnose when numbers move and why

● Strong negotiation and partner management skills; comfortable building and managing external vendor and partner relationships independently

● Senior individual contributor mindset ,  you thrive working independently, go deep on execution without needing a team beneath you, and bring enough seniority to set strategy and defend decisions to leadership without hand-holding

**Nice to Have**

● Experience running performance marketing specifically for a social, entertainment, or consumer app

● Exposure to influencer or KOL-driven paid amplification as an acquisition channel

● Familiarity with incrementality testing, geo-splits, or media mix modelling

● SQL or BI tool fluency (Looker, Tableau, Metabase) for self-serve analysis

**What We Offer**

● Top-of-market compensation

● Full ownership of a critical function from day one, inside a company with the infrastructure, ad tech depth, and platform relationships to back you up

● A lean, high-trust environment where decisions move fast and your impact is direct and visible

- Have a sharp eye for detail and a strong command of design fundamentals such as typography, layout, color, composition, and visual storytelling.

- Are advanced in Adobe Creative Suite skills, with real depth in Photoshop and Illustrator.

- Have an ability to navigate 3D and Figma project files to locate, extract, or make minor adjustments to the assets you need.

- Advanced motion graphics skills.

- Experience creating key art and promotional illustrations for game campaigns.

- Experience with mobile gaming and performance-marketing principles.

- Hands-on 3D skills.

With one more game in the works, we are continuing our efforts to create powerful mobile sports gaming experiences built to last.

- **Meaningful career experience: **work with experienced game makers and mentors who will support you from day one, helping you map a career path that's true to you.

- This is a hybrid, on-site position based in Belgrade.

- **Own App UA at Scale:** Take ownership of app install campaigns across AppLovin, Google UAC, Facebook, TikTok, and DSPs - managing $500k+ in daily spend and optimizing toward revenue and predictive LTV targets.

- **Problem-Solving Operator:** You diagnose, you act, you iterate. You don't wait for weekly reviews to catch a problem ,  you're in the account daily and you fix things before they become fires.

**What Makes You a Great Fit 🌟**

- You treat a live campaign like it's always your responsibility - proactive, not reactive.

- You think in signals and ratios, not just top-line spend.

- You're a confident stakeholder manager who can align internal teams and external agencies toward a shared creative and performance roadmap.

- You're comfortable with complexity - multiple campaign types, channels, and attribution layers - and you build clarity from it rather than getting slowed down by it.

description_md:
**About ElevenLabs**

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

**How we work**

- **High-velocity: **Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- **Impact not job titles: **We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- **AI first:** We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company, from engineering to growth to operations.

- **Excellence everywhere: **Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- **Global team: **We prioritize your talent, not your location.

**What we offer**

- **Innovative culture:** You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- **Growth paths: **Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- **Learning & development**: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- **Social travel**: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- **Annual company offsite: **Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- **Co-working**: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

**About the role**

ElevenReader is our fastest growing app that brings content to life for consumers. As we scale globally, we need a Growth Marketer who can turn creative ideas and strategic partnerships into one of our most powerful acquisition channels.

You’ll own the strategy and execution of growth campaigns that bring millions of new users to ElevenReader through partnerships, integrated marketing, and innovative activations. Think: loyalty programs, co-marketing campaigns, OOH activations, offer-based collaborations, retail partnerships, and testing entirely new distribution channels.

This is a highly cross-functional role that sits at the intersection of growth marketing, creative, partnerships, and performance marketing. You’ll develop creative campaigns, launch new acquisition channels, build scalable partnership playbooks, and rigorously measure what works. You’ll work closely with Performance Marketing to ensure every activation drives measurable full-funnel user growth while strengthening the ElevenReader brand.

**What you will do**

- Building and scaling strategic consumer partnerships that drive acquisitions for ElevenReader

- Developing integrated marketing campaigns spanning partnerships, paid media, email, social, OOH, PR, and product surfaces

- Expanding existing telecom & loyalty partnerships while launching new opportunities with partnersIdentifying and launching new distribution channels across loyalty platforms, retail, education, public sector, travel, and commerce.

- Creating bundled value propositions that make ElevenReader a compelling consumer benefit or offer

- Managing co-marketing campaigns with strategic partners from creative development through launch and post-campaign analysis

- Writing compelling campaign messaging, design copy, landing pages, and emails/push that convert

- Partnering with Design to produce best-in-class creative assets while maintaining exceptional brand quality

- Measuring campaign performance across attribution models, incrementality, CAC, LTV, retention, and ROAS, continuously optimizing for business growth

**Requirements**

- 10+ years of experience in growth marketing, partnerships, consumer marketing, or integrated marketing at a high-growth technology or consumer company

- Exceptional growth marketing instincts ,  equally comfortable developing creative campaigns and analyzing acquisition performance

- Experience launching and scaling partnership marketing programs that drive measurable user acquisition

- Strong understanding of attribution, experimentation, ROAS, incrementality, and performance analytics

- Excellent copywriting skills with an eye for memorable campaigns and high-converting, differentiated messaging.

- Strong creative judgment and taste. You know what great marketing looks like and can work effectively with designers and creative teams.

- Outstanding project management skills with the ability to coordinate multiple cross-functional launches simultaneously.

**Bonus**

- Experience with lifecycle and loyalty marketing programs that improve acquisition and retention

- Experience with performance marketing and affiliates

- Curiosity about emerging distribution opportunities and the creativity to turn unconventional partnerships into scalable growth channels.

- Passion for consumer products, AI, and building globally loved brands.

**Location**

This role is remote with a preference for timezones in US - East and Europe

Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work ,  both in and out of the office.

ŌURA is seeking a detail-oriented and performance-driven Paid Social Specialist (US) to support the execution and optimization of our paid social programs. This role is highly executional, focused on campaign setup, optimization, testing, and performance analysis across platforms such as Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, and other emerging social channels.

You’ll work closely with Paid Media leadership, channel leads, analytics, creative, and agency partners to ensure paid social campaigns are structured effectively, optimized rigorously, and aligned to both performance goals and regional campaign priorities.

What You’ll Do

Paid Social Execution

- Build, launch, and optimize campaigns across Meta, TikTok, and other social platforms (e.g. Reddit, Pinterest, Snapchat, etc).

- Manage audience targeting, budget allocation, creative trafficking, and campaign structure to drive efficient growth.

- Conduct ongoing performance monitoring and implement daily/weekly optimizations.

**Testing & Creative Optimization**

- Support structured testing across creative variations, audiences, placements, and bidding strategies.

- Analyze performance trends (CTR, CVR, CAC) to uncover optimization opportunities that support both channel performance and regional campaign objectives.

- Partner with Creative to provide data-informed feedback on messaging, formats, and content iterations.

**Technical & Platform Operations**

- Maintain clean account structure and campaign documentation.

- Support audience uploads, exclusions, and segmentation strategies.

- Translate performance data into clear insights and recommendations for both media and regional stakeholders in weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting.

- Comfort analyzing data and translating performance metrics into optimization actions.

- Detail-oriented, highly organized, and comfortable operating in-platform daily.

- Deep hands-on expertise within paid social, with a focus on executional excellence and optimization rigor.

- Critical to driving scalable customer acquisition through social platforms.

- Embedded within a global paid media team focused on measurable growth across multiple regions.

- Strong analytical skills; comfortable in data/analytics tools and confident drawing conclusions from them

- A sharp eye for visual strategy and the ability to give editors direction that improves the work

- Experience sourcing or managing creator relationships/content

- Excellent collaborator able to work across brand, editorial, and creative teams and keep everyone aligned to the same strategy

description_md:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to **200 employees** while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a **$400 million Series D** at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination.

About the Role

Suno’s growth runs on paid social, and paid social runs on creative. This is the role that decides what that creative is and why: the strategist who turns audience insight into the concepts everyone else executes. You’ll lead the audience and market research that uncovers new angles, pain points, and use cases, then turn them into a steady backlog of concepts and briefs that designers and editors run with across Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok.

This is a high-ownership role with real strategic latitude. You won’t be handed a brief and told to fill it, you’ll write the briefs. You’ll bring your own read on which audiences are worth chasing, what story wins them, and which formats to test, then move fast to test, iterate, and find what wins. Great work here is measured by performance, and you’ll see the results of your concepts quickly enough to act on them.

If you think in audiences and angles, read hook rate and hold rate as fluently as you spot a fresh one, and want your concepts running in front of a massive global audience within days, this one is for you.

What You’ll Do

- Lead deep audience and market research to uncover new personas, pain points, and use cases worth targeting.

- Turn that research into a steady backlog of net-new ad concepts, each with a clear rationale for why it should win.

- Write sharp creative briefs that give designers, editors, and producers a clear direction to execute against.

- Develop angles, hooks, and messaging built around how people actually behave on Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok.

- Define what to test next and why, isolating variables so every result teaches us something.

- Keep a deep bench of fresh ideas in flight to stay ahead of creative fatigue, so no single winner carries the account too long.

- Partner with performance marketing managers to turn account needs into concrete creative direction.

- Read performance signals and feed them back into sharper concepts, as bandwidth allows.

What You’ll Need

**Must-Haves**

- Proven experience as a creative strategist in a high-volume, high-velocity performance creative environment.

- A strong track record of paid social creative for live Meta and/or TikTok campaigns, with results you can speak to.

- A real grasp of direct-response creative: audiences, angles, hooks, and why an ad wins or loses, not just how it looks.

- Deep fluency in audience and market research, and the instinct to turn it into non-obvious angles.

- The range to own strategy end to end and the scrappiness to write the hooks and do the research yourself. No task is beneath you.

- A proactive, self-directed working style. You spot what’s missing and bring ideas without being asked.

- Fluency in Motion (or a comparable creative analytics tool) to read what’s driving performance and act on it.

- Comfort reading metrics such as hook rate, hold rate, and CTR, and turning them into the next round of concepts.

**Nice-to-Haves**

- Experience at a consumer subscription app, a growth agency running paid social, or a DTC/ecommerce brand.

- Comfort folding AI tools into research and ideation to move faster.

- A love of music and an eye for culture.

**Compensation**

This is a contract role paying $80 to $120 per hour, depending on experience, at roughly 20 to 40 hours per week.

**Additional Notes**

Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

description_md:
**About ElevenLabs**

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

**How we work**

- **High-velocity: **Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- **Impact not job titles: **We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- **AI first:** We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company, from engineering to growth to operations.

- **Excellence everywhere: **Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- **Global team: **We prioritize your talent, not your location.

**What we offer**

- **Learning & development**: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- **Social travel**: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

About the role

We’re hiring a Paid Media Manager to scale our paid acquisition across the full funnel and every segment, self-serve, developer, and enterprise–for emerging channels (e.g. Reddit, Snap, programmatic, et al). This role owns strategy and execution across the paid funnel, from channel mix and budget to creative testing and landing-page alignment, and is expected to find profitable, scalable growth through experimentation and data-driven decision making.

This role is highly cross-functional and will partner closely with creative, lifecycle, landing-page, product marketing, and sales to drive impact.

What you will do

- Own full-funnel paid media strategy and execution across self-serve, developer, and enterprise segments

- Build scalable systems for paid acquisition, with strong attention to CAC, payback, and pipeline/conversion quality

- Manage channel mix and budget allocation across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, and emerging channels

- Move fast: run A/B tests, analyze performance, iterate quickly, and document learnings

- Instrument tracking, attribution, and reporting so paid impact is measurable end-to-end

- Elevate experimentation velocity and platform diversity to uncover untapped growth

Requirements

- Proven track record of scaling paid programs profitably across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, and other channels

- Hands-on platform expertise, you’ve personally built and optimized campaigns, not just managed an agency

- Strong analytical chops, you understand attribution, tracking, and LTV vs CAC math without needing a second opinion

Bonus

Growth potential

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:
